title: Battle of Sylhet
subtitle: Eastern-front fighting isolates Pakistani positions around Sylhet.
summary: The Battle of Sylhet unfolded during the final phase of the 1971 war as Indian and Mukti Bahini-linked operations pressured Pakistani forces in the northeast. The battle helped isolate the Sylhet region before surrender.
heroTagline: Eastern-front fighting isolates Pakistani positions around Sylhet.
whyItMatters: Sylhet adds the northeastern theater to the final campaign narrative.
